inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein, former advisor to the Israeli Prime Minister, notes that amid the ongoing West Asia conflict a political resolution is vital for success. He emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation. This position really reveals how entrenched elites prioritize aggressive posturing and dominance over the structural reforms and equitable political solutions needed to dismantle inequality, protect vulnerable populations on all sides, and address the historical power imbalances driving the conflict.
